input: nodered: the pinned container image is three minor versions behind the release that carries the fix for a published advisory.
rustfs: thirteen security fixes are listed in a release's notes with no advisory behind any of them, and the pinned version is below that release.
freepbx: the container image was abandoned by its maintainer in 2022. Three CRITICAL CVEs against it have no fixed release to move to.
traefik: the edge still accepts TLS 1.0 and 1.1 because the rendered dynamic configuration sets no minimum version.
mariadb: client connections negotiate plaintext because require_secure_transport is never set in the rendered server settings.
The red-state reader counted UNREAD notifications rather than open findings, so an event nobody had opened rendered as current state long after it stopped being true.
A dashboard panel judged any non-zero exit code as a failure, while the job table already declares which exit codes mean "this job found something".
Alert NosWarningDiskLow is firing on the host: its root volume is at 92% and falling by about a gigabyte a day.
Scheduled job backup:backup-restore-drill last exited 1. No further detail was recorded.
The per-system documentation directory covers about a third of the estate, and several of the pages it does have point at file paths that no longer exist.

There are two implementations of the same small pipeline language in this repository and nothing compares their output, so a divergence between them would surface as a wrong answer rather than as a failure.
mariadb: the pin has not moved, but the image behind that tag has been rebuilt on a newer base layer. A semantic version cannot express the drift.
gitlab: the recorded fix target was corrected upward, and the version currently pinned is below the advisory's fixed release.
ollama: an unauthenticated request can trigger a memory leak during GGUF quantization. It is installed as a host package rather than a container, and the maintainer has published no fix.

The vector index declares its embedding column as 32-bit floats in the schema this repository ships, where 8-bit integers would serve the same recall. There is no setting for it; the column type is written in the migration.
The operator-facing guide still instructs the reader to use a removal flag that was replaced by a different command months ago.
onlyoffice: the document-server JWT secret falls back to an empty string when the vault lookup misses, and the service starts anyway.
A per-user database file is selected from an unauthenticated query parameter, so a caller can name any tenant's database.
The signed ruling carries two rows added after the signature was taken, and the recorded digest correctly reports the document as amended after signing.
Scheduled job librarian:describe-taxonomy last exited 2. Nothing in the run row says which stage exited or why.
